ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED THE TOTAL COMPENSATION PAID FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES OVER THE IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD.
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM A PARTY'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR AN EXCLUDED CLAIM) EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim FOR HOSTING AND SUPPORT SERVICES AND (B) USD 1,000,000.

ops.text: For the purposes of the preceding sentence, "Excluded Claims" means a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its fraud, and its infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights. Neither party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages, and Client's payment obligations, being all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages for the purposes of the cap.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the existing cap mutual and set it at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, since our position is a mutual cap rather than one protecting TrueLink alone. The added sentence keeps confidentiality, data protection and security breaches, indemnities, fraud and IP infringement outside the cap for both parties, excludes indirect and consequential damages mutually, and confirms Client's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
proposal.summary: Make the liability cap mutual at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, with mutual uncapped carve-outs, a mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusion, and Client's payment obligations excluded from damages.

mappings.element: Cap equal to the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
Uncapped breach of data protection obligations.
Uncapped infringement of the other party's IP.
Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
